name: ad_partner_ports_probe
description: AD replication partner TCP port health probe. Peer list is centre-computed via GET /api/agent/inbound-partners (R151.2 2026-09-29); the agent only does the TcpClient.BeginConnect probe and emits the result to ad_replication_status.partner_port_status. Independent 15-minute cadence so port health stays fresh even when replication is broken. Data lands in the existing ad_replication_status table via a centre-side post-hook (see center/src/packages/runner.js). NO `database` block by design — this writes to an existing public table, not a new pkg_* schema.
